name: Hypergraph Partitioning Remapping Model
definition: A model to solve the remapping problem in image-space (IS) parallel volume rendering by representing the computational structure as a hypergraph. It establishes interaction between object-space (OS) and image-space to minimize communication cost and maintain load balance when visualization parameters change.
summary: The Hypergraph Partitioning Remapping Model is a parallel volume rendering technique that minimizes communication costs by mapping screen regions to processors via hypergraph partitioning, unlike jagged partitioning which incurs high migration costs.
